description: A long fang gone yellow at the root and brown at the tip. Blightcur's whole jaw is full of them.
lore: Twelve gold, and the yellow is not age — it comes up that colour on a jaw that has never been any other. A [[monsters/plague_hound|Blightcur]]'s leavings cost a bright shape nothing worse than a foul week and a taste of old metal. What they cost somebody already thinning is far more than the fang is worth. Everyone knows it. It is not said aloud at a market, ever.

So the yellow lot lies open with the cheap stock, where every hand in the place goes through it, and the traders watch for the hand that stops. It is not done to be cruel. When a hand stops, the trader finds something to be doing at that end of the stall, and talks, and keeps talking, and by the second visit there is a stool out. Half the fires on that road were told who to go and sit with by a man selling teeth.
gm_notes: Junk as a diagnostic. Market traders on that road can name who is thinning before the fires can, and quietly route company toward them.
